articles.title: Crypto's campaign efforts see rare loss, but crypto roster in Congress likely to grow
articles.snippet: The leading industry PAC, Fairshake, put $2 million into a Detroit Democratic primary but came up short, even as several PAC-backed candidates won elsewhere.

articles.title: "You stole, please return some." Coldcard hacker's wallet becomes a graffiti wall of pleas and hustles
articles.snippet: A wallet holding $36 million in stolen bitcoin has become an unlikely public message board, as hack victims and opportunists pay to leave permanent notes for the thief.

articles.title: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating
articles.snippet: The rating recognizes the fund’s ability to maintain a stable net asset value, while S&P separately reaffirmed USDT among the lowest-rated stablecoins under its existing assessment framework.

articles.title: US, UK reaffirm support for stablecoins, tokenization in joint financial regulation talks
articles.snippet: In a July 8 meeting, US and UK regulators highlighted the implementation of the GENIUS Act, payment modernization and cross-border cooperation, reinforcing a shared framework for digital asset oversight.

articles.title: BNY to offer institutional crypto staking through Galaxy partnership
articles.snippet: The custody giant is expanding beyond safekeeping by adding staking services, allowing eligible institutional clients to earn yield on proof-of-stake assets.
